concerns.text: T013 (surrogate_service) depends on T049b (bridge supercell metadata) and T017c (thermo_consistency_check), but T049b and T017c are listed as pending `[ ]` while T013 is also pending. More critically, T013 depends on T017b/T017a (Spec Amendments) which are also pending. The consumer (T013) cannot proceed until the producer (T049b, T017c, T017a/b) artifacts exist. The current order implies T013 might be attempted before these prerequisites are resolved, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' rule for the data-flow of supercell metadata and spec authorization.

T090 (Create generate_ground_truth.py) and T091 (Execute it) depend on T045e-Fetch (CALPHAD data) and T090-Config. However, T045e-Fetch is marked `[ ]` (pending) and T090-Config is marked `[X]` (done). The task T090 description states it must 'load TCFE9 parameters... from data/raw/calphad_params.json (T045e-Fetch)'. Since T045e-Fetch is pending, the artifact required by T090 does not exist. T090/T091 are consumers of a non-existent producer. They must be reordered to strictly follow T045e-Fetch completion.

T018 (Generate segregation_profiles.json) depends on T014 (McLean model). T014 depends on T013b (load_dft_energies). T013b depends on T045f-Fetch. T045f-Fetch is marked `[ ]` (pending). The chain T045f-Fetch -> T013b -> T014 -> T018 is broken at the source. T018 cannot be executed until T045f-Fetch produces the DFT data artifact. The current listing groups them in Phase 3 without enforcing the strict dependency on the Phase 0.2 fetch tasks.

T095c (Binary Experimental Validation) depends on T095a-Check and T018. T018 depends on T014, which depends on T013b, which depends on T045f-Fetch. T045f-Fetch is pending. Furthermore, T095c requires APT data from T045a-Fetch/T045c-Fetch, which are also pending. The task T095c is a consumer of multiple pending producers (T018, T045a-Fetch, T045c-Fetch). It cannot be executed in the current state. The ordering must reflect that T095c is blocked until all upstream data fetches (Phase 0.2) are complete.

T017a and T017b (Spec Amendments) are listed in Phase 3 (User Story 1) but are prerequisites for T017 (DFT service simulation) and T013 (Surrogate service). While they are listed before T017, the dependency text for T013 explicitly lists T017a/b as dependencies. The visual grouping in Phase 3 is acceptable, but the `[ ]` status of these amendment tasks blocks the entire US1 implementation. The order is technically correct (amendments before implementation), but the pending status of the amendments makes the downstream tasks unexecutable.

T005 (Validate data_manifest.json) depends on T045a-Fetch, T045c-Fetch, T045e-Fetch, T045f-Fetch, T092, T049, T050. T045a/b/c/e/f-Fetch are all marked `[ ]` (pending). T092 is also `[ ]`. T005 is a consumer of these pending producers. It cannot run until the fetch tasks complete and T092 updates the manifest. The current placement in Phase 2 (Foundational) is correct logically, but the pending status of the producers means T005 is currently blocked.
